_comment: The civic band: one line under the horizon on EVERY page, for something the town can act on by a date — a council vote, a consultation, a changed bin week, a road closure. Not for safety notices (notice.json, police-sourced, Today board only) and not for events (What's On). Shown while `starts`..`expires` covers today, via the same currentNotices filter as the safety notice: build-time, self-expiring, at most one at a time, nothing to remember to take down. `href` is normally a page on this site that carries the facts, so the band stays one sentence and the page does the explaining. The band never names a side, a candidate or a project.
_rules: Something a reader can do, with a date it ends.
One sentence and one button. The button goes to a page on this site that has the full facts.
Never names a project, a candidate or a side. The page it points to lists every option equally.
One at a time. If two are live, the later `starts` waits.
Expires on its own; nothing is ever removed by hand.
